title: DART DRACO calibrated images with geometric backplanes
publisher: NASA Planetary Data System, Small Bodies Node

statements.text: Ernst, C., Daly, T., Barnouin, O., Espiritu, R. and Waller, D. (2023), DART Spacecraft Bundle, Calibrated Images with Geometric Backplanes, NASA Planetary Data System, DOI 10.26007/QAAN-F992.
statements.scope: Every DRACO frame and backplane cube used for the Dimorphos mosaic.
statements.evidence: Citation_Information of the collection label in the PDS registry.

statements.text: NASA public scientific data; retain the dataset citation and source notices.
